scope: v0.26.5 RC3 attempt 34 supersedes RC2 attempt 33 from exact production source d3e1a96be09a88cbad84d4a85ca2ff3f9dd495dc, green on the same clean commit across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube. Preserve the V7 native Direct3D 11 GPU shelf architecture, shared GPU asset cache, background GLB-to-HC3D compilation, responsive Providers/Consoles shelves, native turntable animation, per-monitor DPI handling, no distance-to-icon reversion, frozen emulator console selection/open behavior and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upgrade HC3D to cache version 2: when a baked glTF node transform has a negative 3x3 determinant, reverse each triangle winding from 0,1,2 to 0,2,1 so authored CCW front faces remain front-facing. The brightness slider must be visible/actionable, apply live to both D3D11 shelf surfaces through HC_GPU_SetShelfBrightness/SetBrightnessPercent and to the full-screen LiveModelView through SetBrightnessPercent/BrightnessPercent, and persist in PlatformModelBrightness. Preserve correct existing platform abbreviations and all NES/SNES canonicalization. Xbox PC provider remains distinct from Original Xbox hardware and must never resolve Xbox.glb as the provider model. Recomps must be a first-class native provider, not an emulator.
